unreadable: All terminal labels are very small and low-resolution in the inset (top-left Relay Device view); readings are best effort. terminal-3 position 1 could read AGND rather than SGND.
terminal-1 position 2: O and 0 cannot be told apart at this resolution; recorded as T0UT per rule 5.
notes: The only per-terminal labels are on the enclosure faceplate in the top-left inset photo. The 12~24V DC input terminal is marked only +/- and is skipped (rule 1). The 3-way relay output terminal has no legible per-terminal labels and is skipped. Group names (RS232/RS485/CAN) are inferred from the A/B and L/H terminal names only for the connector names. GPIO tables (RS485, RS232, CAN, LCD, LoRa, Ethernet, Touch) are not tied to terminal positions.
uncertain: Terminal labels are read from a small, low-resolution inset; TOUT, RIN and the SGND/AGND first labels in particular may be misread.
Grouping into three 4-terminal blocks follows the visible gaps between the screw blocks; the faceplate labels sit in a continuous strip above them.
